Wrapper: given task, fit by_language model for each language

fit_bylanguage_task.Rd

Calls fit_task_models_pooled() with subset_var = "language" for each language present for task, so task_data must have a language column.

Usage

fit_bylanguage_task(task_data, models, priors, task, registry_dir)

Arguments

task_data

data frame nested by task and grouping variables, with columns item_task, the grouping variable(s) (e.g. language, dataset), and data, a list-column of trial-level data frames with (at least) columns run_id, item_uid, correct (logical or 0/1), and chance (chance level of the item)

models

data frame of models to fit, one per row, with columns nfact (number of factors) and itemtype ("Rasch" or "2PL"), and no other columns

priors

list of priors, where names are parameter names (e.g. d, a1) and values are vectors of length 3 (priorType, val1, val2), e.g. list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, 0.3))

task

one value in item_task

registry_dir

string indicating directory in which to save models

Value

Called for its side effect of writing model files.
